info.title: TikTak.by MCP Analytics API
info.description:
Read-only analytics API powering the local MCP server (tiktak-mcp). All endpoints return a `{query, data, meta}` envelope. All amounts are in BYN.

## Methodology (locked 2026-05-14)

Numbers reproduce the legacy admin reports /bb/reports.php, /bb/sales_breakdown.php, /bb/dohrash2.php, /bb/cat_analysis.php:

- **Revenue** = SUM(r_paid + delivery_paid) over UNION(rent_sub_deals_act, rent_sub_deals_arch), filtered by `acc_date` (accounting date — when the payment landed). Not by parent deal's `cr_time`.
- **Deal/return counts** read UNION(rent_deals_act, rent_deals_arch). The `_act` table holds ~430 currently-open deals; querying only `_arch` would miss them.
- **Office attribution** uses sub_deal.place + delivery_yn (per-payment), not deal.first_rent_place (per-deal). A deal opened at office 1 but extended at office 2 contributes to BOTH.
- **Carnival** items are detected via tovar_rent_cat.cat_type=1. Numeric endpoints accept `include_carnival` (default true). When include_carnival=true /finance/pnl still splits revenue into revenue_carnival_byn / revenue_non_carnival_byn.
- **Inventory** at date X counts both tovar_rent_items (buy_date <= X) and tovar_rent_items_arch (buy_date <= X AND arch_time >= X) — matches tovar::getTovNumberForCatsForDate.
- **/inventory/utilization** denominator uses average of unit counts at period start and end.

## Notes on amount serialization

Amount fields suffixed `_byn` are returned either as JSON numbers or as decimal strings, depending on the endpoint:
- Endpoints that compute the amount in PHP (e.g. /finance/pnl rolls up expense buckets and casts to float) return numbers.
- Endpoints that pass MariaDB ROUND(..., 2) results straight through (DECIMAL columns) return JSON strings such as `"424231.72"`. Always parse `_byn` fields as numeric.

Access: Bearer token (MCP_API_TOKEN), GeoIP-restricted to BY/RU, rate-limited to 60 req/min.

from.name: from
from.description: Period start (ISO date). Default: 12 months ago.

location.name: location
location.description: Office id (1..) for non-courier sub-deals (sub_deal.place=N AND delivery_yn != '1'), 'courier' for delivery_yn='1', or 'all'.

include_carnival.name: include_carnival
include_carnival.description: If false, exclude items in carnival categories (tovar_rent_cat.cat_type=1). Truthy/falsy strings accepted ('true','1','yes' vs 'false','0','no','off').

query.description: Echo of the request parameters with defaults filled in.

AmountBYN.description: BYN monetary amount. May be a JSON number (when the controller casts to float) or a decimal string such as "424231.72" (when MariaDB ROUND(...,2) is passed through directly). Always parse as numeric.

Ratio.description: Conversion ratio in [0..1]. Null when the denominator is zero.

OperationsFunnelData.description: May be `[]` (empty array) when category resolves to no razdel.

office_type.description: 'office', 'courier', or null when offices row is missing.

InventoryFreeTreeData.description: Catalog tree: section → subsection → category → model.

total_units.description: Sum of free_units across all models in this category.

units_at_from.description: Historical unit count at period start (active + alive-archived).

units_at_to.description: Historical unit count at period end.

last_deal_ts.description: Unix timestamp of the last deal touching this model. Null = never.

unique_clients_proxy.description: DISTINCT deal_id of issuance sub-deals — proxy for unique customers visiting that office in that period.

avg_payment_byn.description: Average sub-deal payment (NOT average per deal).

first_activity_date.description: Earliest sub_deal.acc_date for this office. Renamed from first_deal_date in v2.0.0.

last_activity_date.description: Latest sub_deal.acc_date for this office. Renamed from last_deal_date in v2.0.0.

seasonality_index.description: deals / (totalDeals / monthsObserved). 1.0 = average month; 6.7 = December for costumes.

total_revenue_byn.description: Pre-aggregated per item to avoid M:N inflation through subrazdel_category × razdel_subrazdel.

doh_rash expenses by period × type2 × channel.

Current catalog tree with free-unit counts.
Per-physical-item profitability across UNION(deals_act, deals_arch).
Per-model utilization = rented_seconds / (avg_units × period). Historical inventory at date = active items (buy_date<=ts) + archived items still alive (buy_date<=ts AND arch_time>=ts).
Per-model turnover = deals / units.
Models without rentals for at least N days.
Per-period new / active / returning / new-active customer counts.
Monthly cohort × observed retention matrix.
Distribution of intervals between consecutive deals (mean/p25/median/p75/histogram).
Per-client LTV ranking across UNION(deals_act, deals_arch). No PII.
Distinct clients × deals × revenue by trimmed/lower-cased city.

Per-period × per-office revenue, deals, issuance_events. Office attribution via sub_deal.place + delivery_yn (per-payment). office_id=0 is the Курьер pseudo-office. avg_payment_byn is per sub-deal payment, not per deal.
Office full lifecycle: first/last activity date (sub_deal.acc_date), total revenue, currently_active flag.
Monthly seasonality_index for a business category over the last N years.
Per-category deals + revenue + active models. Revenue pre-aggregated per item to avoid M:N inflation. Requires date_from + date_to (NOT from/to).
Carnival booking funnel: bookings → approved → issued → returned. Source: karn_brons + karn_brons_arch (separate from regular rentals).
Monthly carnival seasonality_index. December is the peak.

Per-period carnival revenue by payment channel (k1/k2/terminal/bank). NOTE: this is the karn_brons pre-booking system — separate from /finance/revenue which sums rent_sub_deals. DO NOT sum both — that double-counts carnival revenue.
Streaming CSV export. Topics: operations, revenue, pnl, traffic. Column layout matches data/monthly/_schema.md.
